The '''Shakamm Crater''' was the location of an impact that changed forever the [[Aurea]]'s surface. Later, a group of [[Artisan/Legends|artisans]] of the [[Mardri Soulworks Collective]] used burning crystals from the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations located there to create objects.
